title: Happy by the Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perfectly positioned between the charming communities of Blue Mountain and Dune Allen, this luxurious retreat captures the essence of 30A living. From the moment you step inside, a sense of relaxation and warmth welcomes you to unwind in an impeccably designed space. Soaring ceilings and sunlit open living areas create an inviting ambiance, while the gourmet kitchen—complete with top-tier appliances—makes every meal a delight, whether you’re dining indoors or by the pool. The private backyard is a serene oasis, featuring a lushly landscaped pool area ideal for making memories that will last a lifetime. Accommodating up to 14 guests, the home boasts six spacious bedrooms and four bathrooms, offering plenty of room for both shared moments and private retreats. Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless adventures in nearby Choctawhatchee Bay and the Gulf of Mexico, with opportunities for boating, fishing, and more. Whether it’s a multi-family getaway or an intimate escape, this exceptional home blends coastal elegance with modern convenience, creating a sanctuary where every detail inspires relaxation and joy.
